_doc: Why each GEF card's compile differs from the parser's (tests/gef_parity.py). Kinds: PARSER-APPROX (the parser reads an approximation GEF refuses), FORMAT-GAP (GEF can't say it; the line is unread), ENGINE (GEF says it, the engine can't run it yet: refused, unread), GEF-MORE (GEF reads what the parser leaves unread), EQUIVALENT (different structure, same behavior).
Akroma's Will: PARSER-APPROX: the parser always takes both modes; GEF takes both only with a commander out (if/else on cmdr_out, T3 step 3). Both hold it as a protect answer. Same games in the probe (no commander).
Ancient Silver Dragon: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'no maximum hand size for the rest of the game' (after the d20 trigger) as an always-on static; GEF has it only inside the refused d20 trigger (roll_die is ENGINE).
Arcane Denial: PARSER-APPROX: the parser draws the delayed 'next turn's upkeep' card at once; GEF's delayed trigger is ENGINE (no delayed effects), so the draw is unread.
Become the Avalanche: GEF-MORE: the draw per power-4 creature and the team pump read; the parser leaves the card blank.
Biorhythm: FORMAT-GAP: each player's life becomes their own creature count; the parser's biorhythm effect approximates opponents' boards (PARSER-APPROX).
Cabal Coffers: PARSER-APPROX: the parser also taps Coffers for {B} with no input (mana read from produced_mana) besides the {2} filter with a Swamp count; GEF's counted mana amount is ENGINE (not mapped).
Deflecting Swat: FORMAT-GAP: redirecting a spell has no construct, so the card isn't held as a redirect answer; the free-with-commander cast reads.
Enter the Infinite: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'no maximum hand size until your next turn' as an always-on static; GEF's count of cards in library is ENGINE.
Ephemerate: GEF-MORE: the flicker of your own creature reads (engine flicker, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread (t2_misreads).
Esper Sentinel: FORMAT-GAP: the tax amount is this creature's power; the parser reads a flat tax (PARSER-APPROX).
Exotic Orchard: FORMAT-GAP: colors depend on opponents' lands; the parser assumes any color (PARSER-APPROX).
Feed the Swarm: ENGINE: the life loss equal to the removed permanent's mana value has no count, so the spell is refused whole; the parser drops the life loss and holds the removal (PARSER-APPROX).
Fellwar Stone: FORMAT-GAP: colors depend on opponents' lands; the parser assumes any color (PARSER-APPROX).
Finale of Devastation: ENGINE: a search of library and/or graveyard isn't mapped (the engine's tutor reads the library only); the parser searches the library only (PARSER-APPROX).
Gamble: PARSER-APPROX: the parser discards the worst card; GEF discards at random (discard_rand, T3 step 3).
Gemstone Caverns: FORMAT-GAP + ENGINE: the opening-hand line is a gap, and the mana split on a luck counter is a conditional mana ability the adapter refuses; the parser taps it for {C}.
Ghostway: PARSER-APPROX vs GEF: both hold it as a protect answer; GEF also runs its flicker of all your creatures until the end step when cast (engine delayed flicker, T3 step 3).
Gifts Ungiven: FORMAT-GAP: an opponent picks which two you keep; the parser tutors all four (PARSER-APPROX).
Grasp of Fate: ENGINE: 'for each opponent, up to one target' (Target.for_each) isn't mapped; the parser's single exile was the T2 misread.
Green Sun's Zenith: PARSER-APPROX: the parser ignores 'shuffle Green Sun's Zenith into its owner's library' (it goes to the graveyard); GEF shuffles it in (engine self_shuffle, T3 step 3).
Gwenna, Eyes of Gaea: PARSER-APPROX: the parser restricts the mana to creature spells only; GEF also lets it pay creature sources' abilities (engine 'creature_src', T3 step 3), and reads the power-5 cast trigger the parser leaves unread.
Invasion of Ikoria // Zilortha, Apex of: ENGINE: library-and/or-graveyard search; the back face isn't the card goldfish casts. The parser searches the library only.
Jace, Wielder of Mysteries: ENGINE: the -8's 'then if your library is empty, you win' needs a library_empty condition the engine lacks, so the -8 is refused; the parser reads its draw seven (and wins through the static).
Jeska's Will: ENGINE: the commander condition reads now, but the impulse mode (exile the top three, play them this turn) isn't in the engine; the parser reads both modes, impulse as draw 3 (PARSER-APPROX).
Klauth's Will: ENGINE: the commander condition reads now, but its removal modes target 'up to X' creatures, which the adapter refuses; the parser holds it as removal.
Klauth, Unrivaled Ancient: ENGINE: the attack mana is restricted to spells and persists through phases; mana_x carries no restriction, so it's refused. The parser reads unrestricted mana (PARSER-APPROX).
Maelstrom of the Spirit Dragon: PARSER-APPROX: the parser treats the Dragon-or-Omen mana as unrestricted; GEF restricts it to those subtypes (engine restriction ('sub', ...), T3 step 3).
Mage's Attendant: ENGINE: a token with its own abilities isn't mapped (token_card compiles Oracle text, GEF has structure).
Mossfire Valley: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads '{1}, {T}: Add {R}{G}' as a free {R} or {G}; GEF compiles the filter (needs {1} in).
Mox Amber: FORMAT-GAP: colors among your legendary permanents; the parser assumes any color (PARSER-APPROX).
Nature's Rhythm: ENGINE: harmonize with {X} in its cost isn't mapped; the parser reads harmonize ignoring X.
Ponder: FORMAT-GAP: the translator marked the optional shuffle a gap, so the look line is refused; the parser arranges the top three. Same games.
Pongify: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads Pongify as a clean blocker kill although the opponent gets a 3/3 Ape (it skips Beast Within's for the same reason); GEF holds both without a blocker kill. Same games.
Reality Shift: FORMAT-GAP: manifest makes the exile line unread, so the spell isn't held; the parser holds it as removal.
Reanimate: EQUIVALENT: the parser's Target carries an approximation note ('only your own graveyard is modeled'); same search, same games.
Reckless Handling: ENGINE: random discard; the parser discards the worst card (PARSER-APPROX).
Requisition Raid: FORMAT-GAP: spree modes with their own costs; the parser holds both removal modes.
Rhythm of the Wild: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads riot as haste; GEF grants riot, which the engine lacks (ENGINE).
Sakura-Tribe Elder: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'sacrifice: search a basic land' as an ETB search; GEF compiles the sacrifice activation. Same games in the probe.
Savage Ventmaw: ENGINE: the attack mana persists through phases (a gap part), so the trigger is refused; the parser adds plain mana (PARSER-APPROX). Same games.
Seize the Day: PARSER-APPROX: the parser drops 'untap target creature' and reads the extra combat; GEF untaps your best tapped creature too (untap_cr 'one', T3 step 3).
Selvala, Heart of the Wilds: ENGINE: X mana in any combination with X = greatest power isn't mapped; the parser reads a {G} filter (PARSER-APPROX).
Shamanic Revelation: GEF-MORE: ferocious life gain per power-4 creature reads. Same games in the probe.
Shared Animosity: FORMAT-GAP: the count of attackers sharing a type; the parser's atk_share reads it.
Signal the Clans: FORMAT-GAP: a random pick of the three; the parser tutors three (PARSER-APPROX).
Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs: FORMAT-GAP: the front face (an opponent's spell or permanent) is out of scope in GEF; the parser holds it as removal.
Skycloud Expanse: PARSER-APPROX: as Mossfire Valley (the {1} filter read as free mana). Same games.
Step Through: GEF-MORE: the two-creature bounce reads (held removal); the parser leaves it unread.
Sword of War and Peace: GEF-MORE: the combat damage trigger (damage per card in their hand, life per card in yours) reads; the parser leaves it unread.
Teferi's Protection: FORMAT-GAP: phasing and the life lock; the parser holds it as a protect answer.
Thassa's Oracle: ENGINE: the look-at-X devotion line isn't mapped (look count X); the parser's oracle effect reads the win.
The Endstone: GEF-MORE + ENGINE: the cast trigger reads; play_land and set_life are refused. The parser leaves the card blank.
The One Ring: PARSER-APPROX: the parser loses a flat 1 life per upkeep; GEF loses 1 per burden counter.
Thrakkus the Butcher: FORMAT-GAP: doubling each Dragon's own power; the parser's double_pow reads it.
Unnatural Growth: FORMAT-GAP: doubling each creature's P/T; the parser's double_pow reads it.
Victimize: ENGINE: the recursion returns the creatures tapped, which the engine's recur can't say; the parser returns them untapped (PARSER-APPROX).
Vivi Ornitier: ENGINE: the {0} mana ability's activation restriction; the parser reads a {U} source (PARSER-APPROX).
Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger: FORMAT-GAP: one extra mana of the type the land produced; the parser's mana_add reads it. Same games in the probe.
Windfall: ENGINE: each player discards their hand and draws the greatest discarded count (a gap count); the parser's wheel max approximates.
Wishclaw Talisman: ENGINE: the activation is restricted to your turn and the counters start at three (an opponent then gains control, unexpressible); the parser's t2_misreads reads one use.
Witch's Clinic: GEF-MORE: the lifelink-granting activation reads. Same games.
Yusri, Fortune's Flame: GEF-MORE: choose a number, flip that many coins (draw on a win, 2 damage on a loss), cast free this turn on 5 wins (engine flips, T3 step 3; choose_num is pilot policy); the parser reads a draw per attack (PARSER-APPROX).
Canopy Vista: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands' as always tapped; GEF checks the count (etap 'count', T3 step 3).
Cinder Glade: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands' as always tapped; GEF checks the count (etap 'count', T3 step 3).
Prairie Stream: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands' as always tapped; GEF checks the count (etap 'count', T3 step 3).
Smoldering Marsh: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands' as always tapped; GEF checks the count (etap 'count', T3 step 3).
Sunken Hollow: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads 'enters tapped unless you control two or more basic lands' as always tapped; GEF checks the count (etap 'count', T3 step 3).
Mystic Sanctuary: PARSER-APPROX: the parser reads its enters-tapped as always and leaves the recursion to the top unread; GEF checks three other Islands and puts the spell on top (T3 step 3).
Academy Ruins: GEF-MORE: recursion to the top of the library reads (engine recur 'top', T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread.
Hall of Heliod's Generosity: GEF-MORE: recursion to the top of the library reads (engine recur 'top', T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread.
Krark's Thumb: GEF-MORE: flip two, keep one (engine coin_rule, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank. Same games without flips in the probe.
Edgar, King of Figaro: GEF-MORE: the first flips each turn win (engine coin_rule, T3 step 3); the parser leaves the Two-Headed Coin unread.
Tavern Scoundrel: GEF-MORE: two Treasures per won flip and the flip activation (engine flips, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Zndrsplt, Eye of Wisdom: GEF-MORE: flip until you lose at combat, draw per won flip (engine flips, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Okaun, Eye of Chaos: GEF-MORE: combat flips and doubling its P/T per won flip (engine flips and toughness count, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Planar Chaos: GEF-MORE + ENGINE: the upkeep flip (sacrifice on a loss) reads; 'each player flips for each spell, countering on a loss' is refused (cast by each player).
Solitary Confinement: GEF-MORE + ENGINE: the upkeep 'sacrifice unless you discard' reads; skip_step isn't in the engine (refused) and the rest is out of scope. The parser leaves the card blank.
Dragonstorm: GEF-MORE: storm copies the spell per earlier spell this turn (engine storm, T3 step 3); the parser leaves storm unread.
Rule of Law: GEF-MORE: your own one-spell-a-turn limit binds the pilot (engine spell_limit, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread (t2_misreads).
Deafening Silence: GEF-MORE: your own one-noncreature-spell-a-turn limit binds the pilot (engine spell_limit, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread (t2_misreads).
Necrodominance: GEF-MORE + ENGINE: skipping your draw step reads (engine skip_draw, T3 step 3); the pay-any-life draw (a chosen amount), hand size five and graveyard-to-exile are refused, so the card is partial. The parser leaves it blank.
Aetherflux Reservoir: GEF-MORE: life per spell cast this turn reads (engine count tcast_n, T3 step 3); the parser leaves that line unread.
Long-Term Plans: GEF-MORE: the card goes third from the top (engine tutor 'top3', T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread (t2_misreads).
Triskaidekaphile: GEF-MORE: the win with exactly thirteen cards in hand reads (engine cond hand_eq, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread.
Astral Slide: GEF-MORE: on each cycle, a creature is flickered until the next end step (engine delayed flicker, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Astral Drift: GEF-MORE: flicker until the next end step on your cycles and when cycling it from hand (a cycling rider) (engine delayed flicker, T3 step 3); the parser reads less.
Escape Protocol: GEF-MORE: pay {1} on a cycle to flicker your artifact or creature (engine flicker, T3 step 3); the parser read it as stax removal before t2_misreads.
Azami, Lady of Scrolls: GEF-MORE: 'tap an untapped Wizard you control: draw' reads (engine tapcr cost, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Fluctuator: GEF-MORE: cycling costs {2} less (engine cycle_red, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma: GEF-MORE: the attack pump of creatures with power 4 or greater reads, by current power (engine pow_now, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it unread.
Last March of the Ents: GEF-MORE: draw by greatest toughness, then put any number of creatures from hand onto the battlefield (engine put_hand, T3 step 3); the parser leaves it blank.
Show and Tell: GEF-MORE: put your best permanent from hand onto the battlefield (engine put_hand, T3 step 3; the opponents' side is out of scope); the parser leaves it blank.
